title: RepositoryAreasConfig
description: Schema for pm/areas.json mapping repository domains, paths, tech stack, and architectural risk metadata.

deterministicCommand.description: Deterministic build and test command executed before review.

baseBranch.description: Default target base branch for git diff extraction.

areas.description: Map of architectural domain keys to area definitions.

title.description: Human-readable name of the architectural area.

description.description: Summary of responsibilities and invariants owned by this area.

paths.description: Path prefixes or exact relative file paths belonging to this area.

techStack.description: Languages, runtimes, or tools used in this area.

risk_tier.description: Risk classification. Changes matching a 'high' risk_tier area automatically escalate to review_depth: 'architectural'.

structural_boundaries.description: Structural runtime or trust boundaries governed by this area. Touching or crossing these boundaries triggers architectural review auto-escalation.
